purpose: Validate that pointLon/pointLat in the published fast-ice-distance route shapefiles represent the route origin at the mapped emperor colony, before using those attributes as colony-node coordinates.

semantic_test.origin_definition: The attribute point coordinate must lie within 100 m of the first route vertex and be no farther from the first than the last route vertex.
semantic_test.rationale: The published dataset states that shapefiles are measurements of travelable distance from the colonies to the fast-ice edge; this audit verifies the machine-readable orientation rather than assuming it.

support_after_semantic_pass.annual_anchor: pointLon/pointLat on the earliest parseable Date in each colony-season
support_after_semantic_pass.within_season_false_absence_status: not estimable as the primary Zenodo lane because seasonal route-measurement frequency is too sparse; retain for the PDC 2017-2024 tracking dataset after service recovery

prohibited: radius-specific false turnover before semantic pass
selection of route features by movement magnitude
abundance, breeding success or environmental covariates
next_gate_if_passed: Execute the already frozen 0.5/1/2/5/10-km radius curve using earliest-date annual anchors only; report the within-season estimand as unavailable in this lane.
